caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is colored in shades of brown and tan, with subtle shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The top surface of the cylinder features a raised, circular knob-like structure in the center, surrounded by several small, regularly spaced holes near the edge. The side of the cylinder displays a circular label or imprint that includes the readable text "COTTONS" and "MANUFACTURED" along with additional smaller text that is not entirely legible, but "NEW YORK" is discernible at the bottom of the label. The overall composition is minimal, with the object being the sole focus, and there are no other elements, textures, or decorations present in the background.
title: Inkwell
